notes.title: WazHack 1.4.2 patch release
notes.content:
[h3]Major changes since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/264160/view/3204881590034717337]1.4.1[/url]:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added 2 new legendary weapons.
[*] Added an Australian weapon.
[*] Added [url=https://wazhack.mod.io]mod.io[/url] modding support (in addition to Steam Workshop).
[*] Added a new per-class Shop type.
[*] Can now choose portal destination.
[*] Can now disarm/cancel traps.
[/list]

[h3]Minor tweaks:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Make spider monkeys slightly better.
[*] Some throwable weapons can return.
[*] Make puller DEX and arrow enchantment improve chance of not breaking.
[*] Rebalance shuriken range, duration, damage.
[*] Tweak throwing bonus for all knives.
[*] Improve shop UI.
[*] Change shurikens to wielded in stacks.
[*] Change some dual-wielding mechanics.
[*] Prison Cell improvements.
[*] No skill/talent loss while polymorphed.
[*] Optimize and improve some dungeon graphics.
[*] [i]Blessed[/i] Scroll of Taming more likely to fully tame.
[/list]

[h3]Notable bug fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Prevent rare 'no shops' dungeons.
[*] Add missing ring enchantment glows.
[*] Fix dungeon branch Ruling sometimes being lost.
[*] Fix player getting stuck moving on Ladder near a pet.
[/list]

notes.title: WazHack 1.4.1 patch release
notes.content:
Full list of changes since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/264160/view/3115934864079262780]1.4.0[/url]:

[list]
[*] Can now rearrange spells menu, including with gamepad
[*] Mesmerised creatures don't eat unless fed directly
[*] Remove latitude "Detect" button
[*] Fix shortcuts when pets polymorph/grow up
[*] Fix cursed/rotted eggs effects
[*] Allow specialty shops to buy anything they sell
[*] Gamepad bug fixes
[*] Possible fix for physics bug
[*] Allow more in the machine's Center slot
[/list]

notes.title: WazHack 1.4 Public Beta now Available
notes.content:
[h2]New Side Quest[/h2]

This new version adds a new side-quest near to the top of the dungeon, so even new players will get to play it, or at least walk in and get eaten by a grue!

[h2]Joining the Beta[/h2]

To play the beta, go into the Properties/Beta settings in Steam for WazHack, and choose the beta:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5664704/72354c324a277c7a5317bae8b1608e6ad0eff3a2.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5664704/9082bb758f47611933973c2bd33dc0bc698ecaa6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5664704/469244b8a573530a22e0ed9aa7cf2f92c783a47b.png[/img][/url]

There has been a not-so-secret private alpha running since April, and so it's now stabilized into a build for everyone to play.

[h2]Upgraded Underlying Game Engine[/h2]

The previous modding beta was put on hold as engine incompatibilities made upgrades challenging, but all that is now in the past with 100,000 lines of pristine ported code. While this doesn't make much change to the game, beyond a few visual improvements, the big gain is that it's now easier than ever to add more to the game (for the technical: it's written in C# on Unity 2020).

[h2]Reporting Bugs[/h2]

Quite a few bugs were fixed in the porting process, and about half the bugs fixed during the alpha have been pre-existing bugs from the old version. But as always, this is a beta, so there will be more bugs to squish.

Always try to use the in-game bug reporter to report bugs - it sends a copy of your game file to me so I can try to repeat the problem.

[h2]Other Versions[/h2]

This is a beta. The default branch remains the one from 2016, unless you opt-in to the beta. There is always a "previous" build that is a recent but previous build, in case some catastrophic bug shows up in a build and you really want to keep playing.

If you were on the old modding beta, that is now closed; if you need to finish a game, use the "2017" branch.

If you also have the mobile version of WazHack, that won't be updated yet, but will be looked at during the beta. Note though that when the game is ported to iOS and Android, it will target much more modern devices that the old Samsung Galaxy Nexus that was the minimal-spec in 2015, so better graphics (a more direct port of the PC version), but more demanding on performance.

Save files are not compatible between major versions. They [i]should not[/i] change during the beta, but if essential, the "previous" branch can be used so you can finish your current game before updating.

[h2]Detailed Change List[/h2] (not)

It's a game of discovery, so I'm not going to go into too much detail here. Most things should be entirely familiar, but a few things have been tweaked, and a few bugs that could give undesirable... and desirable... results have been fixed.

[b]
Enjoy!

--
Waz[/b]

notes.title: 1.4 alpha build 2248
notes.content:
This build finally implements most of the Steamworks stuff, including Multiplayer. This is a complete rewrite of the Steam code, so anything unexpected is likely a new bug.

Also in this release:

- Allow getting armour in sizes for your pets.
- Add another use for oil, remove an abuse for lamps
- Pixie spawn fix
- Tweaks of visuals of powerstone, golden items, gnomethrone, danger frame,

notes.title: 1.4 alpha build 2181
notes.content:
The red Danger Frame is back - red particles when you're below 30% HP.

Also:
[list]
[*] a usability improvement for Portal Stones (press F while standing near one).
[*] two buffs to the Sorcerer/Sorceress: a little starting food, and a big benefit in the new area.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 1.4 alpha
notes.content: Note that this update breaks save file compatibility. The game will tell you to use an old version - if you need to, there's a "alpha-previous" branch that has the previous-incompatible version.

notes.title: Update 1.3 is coming!
notes.content:
[b]The next big free update is coming! Join the WazHack 1.3 Open Beta to get a preview![/b]

I won't spoil things here by going into detail of all the stuff that's new - I'll leave you to explore, as there are lots of new features, new details, and a couple of entirely new game mechanics!

On the purely technical side of things, this version is ported to an updated graphics engine version (Unity 5). The big benefit from that on PC is that Cloth physics, last seen in version 1.0, has finally been brought back - hair and cloth effects are now active (can be turned off in Options/Graphics/Softbodies if they cause any problems).

To access the beta, right click on "WazHack" in your Steam games list, choose "Properties", then go to the "BETAS" tab and choose "1.3beta1". The game will update and you'll have it!

The beta is a good time to report any minor inconsistencies you stumble across - when you do X because you thought Y, but nothing happened. Some of these can be done fairly easily, whereas after the beta I tend to just fix actual bugs. At least one of the game mechanics still definitely needs some balancing, but feel free to comment on anything - positively or negatively.

Please report bugs and other issues here and/or via the menu option. I will be posting frequent updates to the build as bugs are fixed. If I need to break savefile compatibility and you load a character, you'll get a notice to switch to the previous beta (same process). You cannot load savefiles from version 1.2 (you'll need to go back to the Default release to finish those).

Betas for the web demo and other platforms will commence later in the process.

I hope you enjoy the free update, and thanks for your support over the last year of the Steam release!

[img]http://cloud-4.steamusercontent.com/ugc/714159522733935569/FE4492BF4A1F737404AD709D9D62BCA2D1FE123F/[/img]
